study.question: Does the task allocation of residual-adapter capacity matter for preserving click AUC and reducing measured prediction cost after task-head compression, under fixed buy-only auxiliary context ownership?
study.hypothesis: In the latest matched task-head allocation, keeping buy large preserves click AUC0.6671669182126774, whereas keeping cart or fav large yields0.6663780532090966 at equal parameter count. Since only buy can update shared context and no auxiliary can update shared item/scorer parameters, removing cart/fav private residual channels may preserve click while a matched reduction involving buy may change it. Transfer from towers to residual adapters is unverified. Global dense clipping is an alternative coupling mechanism. This tests allocation conditional on the fixed head configuration, not a new unified architecture.

nearest_work.difference: Exact local parent. Retain its compressed towers, joint summaries and source-gradient ownership. Add only post-template fixed slicing of selected auxiliary residual adapters, then compare three exactly matched adapter allocations.

Archived primary text lines250-274 and317-327 was read: target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and Dice are inherited through the local adaptation. No original DIN reproduction or new pooling claim; the intervention only reduces task-private residual channels after full initialization.

Pinned benchmark constructor and forward lines25-106/123-170 use categorical/sequence/task tokens and stacked hub interaction. This study adds no hubs, broadcasts or token stack; it isolates fixed residual channel allocation in the existing local model. Original INFNet paper is provenance-only and was not audited.

selection_criteria.primary: Full-population validation is_click ROC-AUC; do not select by auxiliary mean.
selection_criteria.reference_rule: Require candidate-reference AUC >= -0.0002 within the same round and absolute AUC >=0.666553547526167 (original g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached minus0.0002). Current parent value0.6671669182126774 gives nominal same-round floor0.6669669182126774. Do not loosen after observing outcomes.
selection_criteria.cost_rule: Require strictly fewer total/dense parameters, p50 model-only batch latency <=0.99 times same-round reference, p95 <=1.01 times reference, and full-validation inference_seconds <=1.01 times reference. Same batch8192/hardware/precision/warmup/loading procedure. Training seconds must be reported; >5% regression is a training-cost tradeoff, not training-efficiency success. A single timing run passes screening only; require repeated paired timing before a supported efficiency claim.
selection_criteria.tie_break: Among click-preserving cost-passing cells, choose lowest p50 then highest click AUC; all three allocations remain in the attribution table.
selection_criteria.auxiliary_tradeoff: Report every task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately. A loss >0.01 AUC on any auxiliary task versus same-round reference must be labeled material auxiliary degradation; never describe such a model as preserving multitask quality. This does not change the click-primary selection score.
selection_criteria.uncertainty: Current frozen-seed outcomes are preliminary. Target three paired seeds for candidate and closest controls only through later authorized host execution; no seed kwargs are proposed. User-cluster paired bootstrap only if the host supplies an authorized interface; no user IDs exist in model forward. Report unavailable intervals explicitly.
selection_criteria.slice_rule: Retain fixed empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history bins and sample/positive/negative counts. Other phase-authorized slices remain exploratory; do not create new bins from validation outcomes.
